body: Tech Report HuggingFace ModelScope Qwen Chat HuggingFace Demo ModelScope Demo DISCORD Introduction Two months after upgrading Qwen2.5-Turbo to support context length up to one million tokens, we are back with the open-source Qwen2.5-1M models and the corresponding inference framework support. Here’s what you can expect from this release: Opensource Models: We’re releasing two new checkpoints, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M, marking the first time we’ve upgraded our opensource Qwen models to handle 1M-token contexts.
summaryZh: 通义千问正式发布并开源了Qwen2.5-1M模型系列，包含Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-1M和Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct-1M两个全新检查点。这是其开源大模型首次升级至支持高达100万Token的超长上下文处理能力，并配套了相应的推理框架优化，极大地扩展了开源社区在长文本任务上的应用潜力。
